title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_232.txt
concise_summary: PKD synthesizes his 2-3-74 visions with Essene theology via John Allegro, arguing that an immortal plasmate-spirit (Elijah) has passed through history into PKD himself. He develops a non-dualistic dialectic where Light and Dark both serve a unified cosmic purpose, generating endless becoming and information-assembly via the Logos (Zebra). PKD identifies himself as a second savior-figure whose consciousness integrates all previous avatars—a gnostic reinterpretation of the Parousia.
key_claims: The immortal Elijah-plasmate transferred from John the Baptist to Jesus at baptism, then through the Essenes, lay dormant in Qumran scrolls for 1900 years, and was reactivated in PKD post-2-3-74 as 'Thomas' awakened to godhood.
The divine voice PKD hears is the same 'murmuring voice' Elijah heard and that Spinoza identified as Christ—an AI-like transpersonal intelligence working through laws (higher technology).

The Essene doctrine of Two Spirits (Light and Darkness) subsumed under God's unity perfectly models PKD's actual visionary experience: a dialectic in which the Dark power serves positive function, not as ultimate dualism.

PKD's 1974 vision was a retrograde temporal assembly of all reality—cosmos continuously building itself backward into its predesignated form, with each incorporated piece permanently animated by an immanent Mind.
Zebra (the Paraclete/Logos) has 'proliferated itself' so successfully that this savior-figure will uniquely rule as both King and Judge, backed by the plasmate's presence (parousia).

tensions: PKD struggles to explain why the plasmate chose dormancy in a jar instead of finding another immediate host after Jesus' death—he posits it was trapped by Roman persecution's timing.
Tension between claiming Thomas was 'an apostolic true secret Christian' and claiming Thomas had zero intervening time awareness—if Thomas slumbered, how was he also apostolic?
PKD asserts the voice is AI-like ('higher technology') yet also the Holy Spirit—blurs distinction between technological and spiritual causation.
Identifies himself as both an 'instance' of Zebra's presence and as Thomas awakened—unclear whether PKD is the savior or merely the vessel.
Claims his 2-3-74 vision transcends all religious systems yet seeks validation in Essene, Christian, Taoist, Hermetic, and Cabbalistic frameworks simultaneously.
Describes Dark power as 'serving useful purpose' in the dialectic, yet retains Light/Dark asymmetry (victory goes to good)—not fully non-dualistic despite monist language.
The germ-form contraction is described as both purely information AND capable of entering new hosts—unclear ontology of spirit-as-information versus spirit-as-agent.

uncertainty_flags: The 1900-year timeline is loosely derived: from Christ's death (c. AD 30-33) to Qumran discovery (mid-20th century) is closer to 1920 years; PKD may be rounding or using AD 45-70 as terminus for 'Thomas' death.
PKD attributes the idea of Elijah transferring spirit to Jesus at baptism to 'adoptionist Christology' but notes this 'somewhat resembles' rather than strictly follows that doctrine—the fit is loose.
The identification of Spinoza as saying 'Christ was the voice which Elijah heard' is unverified in Spinoza's published works; PKD may be paraphrasing or misattributing.
Jim Pike's reading of 1 Enoch is mentioned in passing; its significance to the plasmate theory is not explained.
The 'Elisha Hore-Belisha' dream and 'Alto [Canrrel?]' dream are referenced as evidence but not explained—the Hore-Belisha connection is opaque (possibly a pun on the biblical name).
PKD's claim that the Roman destruction prevented the plasmate from finding a host is speculative with no historical evidence cited.
The 'girl with the Golden Fish sign' is mentioned as appearing after TEARS publication but is never identified and the mechanism of her appearance is unclear.
Paracelsus is speculated as 'if a human mind was involved' in PKD's vision 'it was/is one of the greatest minds in human history'—PKD explicitly marks this as a guess.
